topic: What if there was no football at all?
title: What if there was no football at all?
description: A quick look at a world where football never existed.

scenes.heading: There was no football at all?
scenes.narration: What if there was no football at all?

scenes.heading: Almost every country
scenes.caption: Billions of fans
scenes.narration: Football is played in almost every country on Earth. Billions of people watch it, play it, and argue about it.

scenes.heading: The World Cup
scenes.caption: every 4 years
scenes.narration: No World Cup. Every four years, the whole planet would simply not stop for a month. No goals to celebrate. No heartbreak either.

scenes.heading: Kids playing in the street
scenes.caption: just a ball and open space
scenes.narration: Fields and streets would go quiet. Kids would lose the game that needs nothing but a ball and some open space.
The money would move. Clubs, broadcasters, sponsors and stadium jobs would vanish, and other sports would grow to fill the gap.

scenes.heading: Who would rise?
scenes.narration: Basketball, cricket, rugby and handball would all gain fans. Or a brand new game would appear, built on the same simple idea.

scenes.heading: The idea is old
scenes.narration: And history says the game would come back. People have kicked balls at targets for thousands of years.

scenes.heading: What would take its place?
scenes.narration: So maybe football can never be erased. What do you think would take its place? Tell me in the comments.
